about: Prompts that need a workflow and a wait, for counting how the owner waits: workflow_status calls (polling) against the <workflow_notification>s it gets. Each runs to its end.

prompts.prompt: Start a workflow with three worker agents, each writing a one-line summary of one of /repo/docs/d001.md, d002.md and d003.md (give each repo: your volume), and return their summaries. Tell me the three summaries when it is done.
